portContract.note: CE 612f6bf8 answers BLOCKED/exit 1 for an externally reclaimed run and retains the executions[] entry. The port's own native reconciliation answer stays authoritative and is asserted semantically in target mode whenever the scenario prerequisites hold (history entry retained, reclaimed run no longer active, terminal or port-own blocked state with matching exit code). If the port refuses setup outright (e.g. its Worktrunk gate under an ambient line it does not accept), that unavailability is surfaced distinctly and is never accepted as the reconciliation answer. The golden is CE reference only — neither side is coerced.
